legend-karakoram-highway.slogan: Karakoram Highway – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-karakoram-highway.story: Islamabad to Kashgar over the Khunjerab at 4,693 m. A one-way ride of 578 km, Islamabad to the finish - roughly 10 h 31 in the saddle. It goes by way of Abbottabad, Karakoram Highway, Chilas and Gilgit. The highest point is about 4,700 m. It crosses from Pakistan into China - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Karakoram Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 28 km this is Karakoram Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
